description: This file defines the AccessTokenRepository class, implementing OAuth2 access token management including creation, persistence, revocation, and validation within an OAuth2 server context.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 access token management including creation, persistence, revocation, and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with an access token entity and a bean manager.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new access token entity for a specified client, scopes, and user.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Persists a new access token by storing it in the data store after validation.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Revokes an existing access token by marking it as deleted.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a given access token has been revoked or expired.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the repository with an access token entity and a bean manager.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates a new access token for a client with optional scopes and user identifier.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Stores a new access token, associating it with a user and client, and saving to persistent storage.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Revokes an access token by ID, preventing future use.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Determines if an access token has been revoked or has expired.
